tasks.title: Duplication-audited ECDLP ideation against a 34-proposal committed pool

handoff.objective: Produce 4-6 genuinely new, falsifiable proposals against RQ-ECDLP-002 and the satellite questions that the committed pool does not already contain, and prove the novelty by audit rather than assertion.
inputs: ledger/questions/RQ-ECDLP-002.yaml and the six satellite RQ records in read_scope
The 34 committed proposals against RQ-ECDLP-002 (glob ledger/proposals/*.yaml and filter on question_id) plus the 30 against the satellite questions

knowledge/findings/KN-FIND-007.md (decomposition-yield conservation), KN-FIND-c41ea9.md (complete splitting on the factor-base locus), KN-FIND-e7a3b1.md and KN-FIND-9d2f56.md (H-PSEUDO closed approaches, Betti-Yield duality), KN-FIND-c7d31e.md and KN-FIND-2a8b7e.md (BKK speedup), KN-OPEN-020
constraints: DELIVERABLE ZERO — the duplication audit. Before writing any proposal, execute the glob over ledger/proposals/, filter by question_id, and write duplication_audit.md recording the glob you ran, the file count returned, and a one-line statement of what each existing proposal in your target questions already covers. You may not assert that an idea is new without this audit on file. This is the mechanical form of the never-measured rule (CORR-20260803-8fa302).

Every new proposal carries a `discriminated_from` block naming the NEAREST existing IDEA and stating the concrete observable, object, or quantifier that differs. 'Different framing' is not a discrimination. If you cannot name a differing observable, do not file the proposal.

THREE STANDING SCREENS THIS PROGRAM HAS ALREADY DERIVED. Run each new proposal against all three and record the result in the proposal itself. (1) KN-FIND-007: mean decomposition yield is C(B+m-1,m)/N independent of how the factor base is chosen, so any proposal promising higher MEAN yield at matched size is refuted before it runs — only coverage, relation rank, recognizability, or solve cost are arguable. (2) KN-FIND-c41ea9: on the factor-base sublocus the summation polynomial splits completely at EVERY m by the group law, so any proposal whose observable is a generic-fibre Galois or monodromy statistic is measuring a constant where the attack actually operates. (3) KN-FIND-002 / KN-TECH-005: jet and endomorphism oracle families are GGM-simulable at O(1) overhead and closed at exponent 1/2, so a proposal reopening one must defeat the simulation argument explicitly.

Object-first per docs/inventor-protocol.md: name the tracked object, apply the lossy-projection test, and specify the null-object control that would show the object carries no information. A proposal with no null object is incomplete.

Every proposal carries `heuristic_assumptions` (each with an experimental validation route) and `target_complexity` (time and memory exponents versus Pollard rho and BSGS, with memory and multi-target accounting). Do not soften a conditional claim into an unconditional one.
Mint every IDEA id with `python3 tools/allocate_id.py --next idea --date 20260806` and confirm with `--check` before writing the file. Never grep for the next free number (AGENTS.md rule 14).

PRIMARY SOURCES ARE UNREACHABLE from this environment (eprint, arXiv, NIST are blocked). You therefore may not label any idea's novelty stronger than `unverified`, and you may not dismiss an idea as known either.

Bias toward exponent-moving objects per docs/target-result-profile.md. A constant-factor or logarithmic improvement is admissible but must say so in its own title and target_complexity — this corpus already contains a constant-factor BKK line billed in commit messages as a ~50x crypto improvement, and that inflation is the failure mode to avoid.
Write ONLY under your write_scope. Never overwrite an existing proposal file. Do not create hypothesis records, do not approve anything, do not commit.
Never fabricate a citation, a measurement, a run, or a record ID (AGENTS.md rule 9). If a number is not in a committed artifact you can name, it does not go in a proposal.

tasks.title: Freeze EXP-ICEX-146ff5: the arity threshold as an executable contract

handoff.objective: Convert IDEA-20260803-fa9839 into a specified hypothesis H-ICEX-9e54c2 and a FROZEN, approved experiment contract EXP-ICEX-146ff5 that an Executor can run in this environment with no new compute and no unavailable dependency.
inputs: KN-FIND-007 / EV-FBG-001: the exact conservation identity mean yield = C(B+m-1,m)/N, deviation exactly 0 across 144 cells
IDEA-20260801-021 and KN-OPEN-020: the Bezout bound |F_p| <= 3 d_p and the honest statement that the universal version is open
GOAL-ICEX-001's own next_action, which has held this goal non-executing pending SDEG/MONO/RELN packages that are themselves waiting
constraints: THE CONTRACT MUST BE EXECUTABLE HERE. SageMath and g6k are ABSENT; numpy is present. This proposal was selected precisely because it is a derivation plus arithmetic, needing no ECDLP solve. If the design needs an absent dependency, you have designed the wrong experiment — redesign it.

THE VALIDATION GATE IS MANDATORY AND IS THE POINT. IDEA-20260803-fa9839 requires that the cost model reproduce the KNOWN extension-field index-calculus exponent before its prime-field output may be read at all. Specify that reproduction as a hard gate with a numeric tolerance: if the model does not recover the known exponent, the run is invalid and the prime-field threshold is not reported. A cost model that cannot fail its own calibration measures nothing.

The deliverable is a THRESHOLD FUNCTION, not a verdict: for each arity m, how cheap the decomposition oracle must be for index calculus to beat rho, derived from the conservation identity plus a parameterized descent cost with explicit relation-collection, linear-algebra, target-descent, memory and multi-target terms. Every term charged, per GOAL-ECDLP-001's own objective.

MANDATORY CONTROLS. (1) The known-exponent reproduction gate above. (2) A null-object control: a factor base with no structure at all must produce the SAME threshold, because KN-FIND-007 says mean yield cannot depend on factor-base choice — if the model gives a structure-dependent mean yield it has a bug, and this control is what catches it. (3) A degenerate-parameter check that must fail: at oracle cost equal to exhaustive search, the model must report that index calculus loses to rho.

SCOPE DISCIPLINE. This contract produces a cost THRESHOLD, not an algorithm and not evidence that any threshold is reachable. It may not assert that prime-field ECDLP is weakened, that a sub-rho algorithm exists, or that any oracle achieving the threshold has been constructed. State that explicitly in the specification and in the hypothesis's test boundary.

State what the threshold does for the blocked satellites: the contract must define the exact output that tells SDEG, DREG and SIG whether their measured solving degrees can land inside a winning window. That is the deadlock exit and it is a declared deliverable, not a hoped-for side effect.

The hypothesis record must state mechanism, predictions with metrics, test boundary, and falsification criteria (AGENTS.md rule 2). The contract must state controls, metrics, budgets, stopping rules, and required artifacts BEFORE execution (rule 3).
This task SPECIFIES and APPROVES a contract. It runs nothing, changes no goal status, and promotes nothing to knowledge/. Do not commit.
Use the pre-allocated ids H-ICEX-9e54c2 and EXP-ICEX-146ff5 exactly; both were --check confirmed free at batch open.

tasks.title: Red-team the ECDLP proposals and the arity-threshold contract

handoff.objective: Attack this batch on two fronts: are the new proposals actually new and do they survive the program's own three standing screens, and can the arity-threshold contract produce a number that means anything?
inputs: The committed proposal pool for RQ-ECDLP-002 and the satellite questions
constraints: Independent session. You did not produce these artifacts and you do not repair them.

DUPLICATION IS THE PRIMARY ATTACK. For each new proposal, independently check the nearest-neighbour claim: open the proposal it says it is discriminated from AND at least two others you pick yourself. A proposal that restates an existing one in new vocabulary is a finding, not a contribution.

RE-RUN THE THREE STANDING SCREENS YOURSELF. (1) Does the proposal promise higher mean yield at matched factor-base size? KN-FIND-007 refutes it outright. (2) Is its observable a generic-fibre statistic that KN-FIND-c41ea9 shows is constant on the factor-base sublocus? (3) Does it reopen a GGM-simulable oracle family without defeating the simulation argument? Report the producer's screen verdicts AND your own; disagreement is a finding.

CONTROL-CANNOT-FAIL IS THE SECOND ATTACK (KN-TECH-1a5b7e). For every control in EXP-ICEX-146ff5 and every null object in the new proposals, state whether it is capable of returning a negative. Pay particular attention to the known-exponent reproduction gate: is its tolerance so wide that any model passes?

ATTACK THE COST MODEL SPECIFICALLY. GOAL-ECDLP-001's objective requires preprocessing, relation collection, linear algebra, target descent, verification, memory and multi-target accounting, all charged against rho and BSGS. Name every term the specification omits or charges at zero. An omitted term is the single most common way a threshold comes out favourable.

Check the contract against AGENTS.md rules 6 and 7 and docs/claims-and-verification.md: does anything in it license a claim that prime-field ECDLP is weakened, or present a derived threshold as though an oracle meeting it exists?
Verify the contract's dependency claim yourself. If it needs anything beyond numpy, say so — an unrunnable contract is a defect at design time.
Name the single cheapest observation that would falsify the top-ranked new proposal, and the single cheapest that would invalidate the contract's output.
You write objections. You do not change status, do not edit raw artifacts, and do not commit.
